description: This file defines a Perl package for a ResultSet class related to blacklisted usernames in a database schema, including methods for adding usernames and checking if a username is okay.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::BlacklistUsername
classes.description: A ResultSet class for managing blacklisted usernames within the database schema, extending core ResultSet functionalities and including methods specific to username blacklisting.

methods.name: add_username
methods.description: Adds a username to the blacklist with optional additional column data.

methods.name: is_username_ok
methods.description: Checks if a username is not blacklisted, referencing external component logic.
